sources.title: Manx Radio, Full list of Bank Holidays confirmed for 2026 (13 September 2025)
sources.said: Treasury confirms 11 Bank Holidays for the Isle of Man. Treasury has confirmed all the Bank Holidays for 2026. The list in full: Thursday 1 January (New Year's Day); Friday 3 April (Good Friday); Monday 6 April (Easter Monday); Monday 4 May (Early May Bank Holiday); Monday 25 May (Spring Bank Holiday); Friday 5 June (TT Bank Holiday); Monday 6 July (Tynwald Day Bank Holiday); Monday 31 August (Summer Bank Holiday); Friday 25 December (Christmas Day); Saturday 26 December (Boxing Day); Monday 28 December (Substitute for Boxing Day).

sources.title: Isle of Man Today, Mark your calendars: 2026 bank holidays announced for Isle of Man (Tom Curphey, 11 September 2025)
sources.said: The Isle of Man Government has released the dates of the public bank holidays for 2026. Treasury has confirmed the dates in accordance with the provisions of the Bank Holidays Act 1989. [Same eleven days: 1 Jan, 3 Apr, 6 Apr, 4 May, 25 May, 5 Jun (TT Bank Holiday), 6 Jul (Tynwald Day Bank Holiday), 31 Aug, 25 Dec, 26 Dec, 28 Dec (Substitute for Boxing Day).]
